set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: baseline pwquality.conf backup ==="
sudo -n cp -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.bak.$(date +%s) 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf

echo "=== STEP 2: apply policy (minlen=12, minclass=3) ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-benchmark-policy.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
minlen = 12
minclass = 3
EOF
sudo -n sed -i -E 's/^#?\s*minlen\s*=.*/minlen = 12/' /etc/security/pwquality.conf
grep -q '^minlen' /etc/security/pwquality.conf || echo 'minlen = 12' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf > /dev/null
sudo -n sed -i -E 's/^#?\s*minclass\s*=.*/minclass = 3/' /etc/security/pwquality.conf
grep -q '^minclass' /etc/security/pwquality.conf || echo 'minclass = 3' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf > /dev/null

echo "=== STEP 3: effective config ==="
sudo -n cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf
echo "-- conf.d --"
sudo -n cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-benchmark-policy.conf

echo "=== STEP 4: create test user ==="
sudo -n useradd -M -s /usr/sbin/nologin pwtestuser 2>/dev/null || echo "user already exists"

echo "=== STEP 5: negative test - short password (8 chars, 2 classes) should be REJECTED ==="
if printf 'abcd1234\n' | sudo -n passwd --stdin pwtestuser 2>&1; then
  echo "RESULT: UNEXPECTED ACCEPT (too short)"
else
  echo "RESULT: correctly rejected (too short / too few classes)"
fi

echo "=== STEP 6: negative test - 12 chars but only 2 classes (lower+digit) should be REJECTED ==="
if printf 'abcdefgh1234\n' | sudo -n passwd --stdin pwtestuser 2>&1; then
  echo "RESULT: UNEXPECTED ACCEPT (only 2 classes)"
else
  echo "RESULT: correctly rejected (only 2 classes)"
fi

echo "=== STEP 7: positive test - 12+ chars, 3 classes (lower+upper+digit) should be ACCEPTED ==="
if printf 'Abcdefgh1234\n' | sudo -n passwd --stdin pwtestuser 2>&1; then
  echo "RESULT: correctly accepted (12 chars, 3 classes)"
else
  echo "RESULT: UNEXPECTED REJECT"
fi

echo "=== STEP 8: verify test user password status ==="
sudo -n passwd -S pwtestuser

echo "=== STEP 9: cleanup test user ==="
sudo -n userdel -r pwtestuser 2>/dev/null || sudo -n userdel pwtestuser

echo "=== DONE ==="
